# AiPASS Desktop

> Open-source, Thai-first AI coding agent and agent harness for Windows, macOS and Linux. MIT licensed, zero dependencies.

AiPASS Desktop is a desktop app for running a reviewable AI coding agent in your project. It connects to de.aipass.net through your own logged-in Chrome tab, stages every file edit as a diff you approve, and keeps sessions you can resume or fork.
